sql: select id,course,seq,acip,wylie,english from corpus_segments where wylie like ? order by course,seq

rows.acip: ,BRDZUN DU SMRA BA'I NI, ZHING LAS DANG GRU SPYOD PA'I LAS KYI MTHA' RGYAS PAR MI 'GYUR BA DANG MTHUN PAR MI 'GYUR ZHING PHAL CHER BSLU BA DANG 'JIGS PA DANG 'JIGS SU RUNG BA'I RGYU MANG PO DANG LDAN PA DANG ,
rows.wylie: brdzun du smra ba'i ni, zhing las dang gru spyod pa'i las kyi mtha' rgyas par mi 'gyur ba dang mthun par mi 'gyur zhing phal cher bslu ba dang 'jigs pa dang 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyu mang po dang ldan pa dang
rows.english: Because you have lied, you live in a world where, when you undertake farming or some work in cooperation with other people, in the end the work fails to prosper, and the people can't work well together, and for the most part everyone is cheating one another, and is afraid, and where there are many things to be afraid of.
